high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Madison Beer (@madisonbeer). The post features two side-by-side photos of Madison Beer, both taken against a plain, light-colored background. In the left photo, she is wearing a black sleeveless dress and has her hair down, with one hand on her hip and the other touching her ear. In the right photo, she is also in the same outfit, but her hair is styled differently, and she has both hands on her hips. Above the photos, there is a tweet from "Madison Beer Charts" (@madisonchart) dated 08/10/
